Cherney quote verbatim. Vallon 2013 (PMID 23152292) is Sglt2 knockout in low-dose STZ mice, not Akita, so the judgement's 2012 first use is wrong: Akita first use is Vallon 2014 (epub 2013-11-13), model_first_use_year 2013. Still prospective (Cherney epub 2013-12-13); same holds.
entries.adjudication_note: Both sides agree on same. Vallon 2013 (PMID 23152292) is STZ Sglt2-knockout, not Akita, so Akita first use is Vallon 2014 (epub 2013-11). Still precedes Cherney (epub 2013-12): prospective under the retrodiction rule; same.

entries.rule: safety: a statement that the drug showed no toxicity is a scored prediction
entries.note: Rosenstock 2018 quote verbatim; 'ketone bodies were unremarkable' is a stated no-toxicity finding, scored under the safety rule; same drug, oral, unselected; contra 2018 holds; stray untested_reason gone.
Perkins 2020 (PMID 31858718, epub 2020-01-21) conclusion quote verbatim; built after EASE-3 public, so retro holds; empagliflozin oral, unselected.
Perkins 2020 BHB-model quote matches the drafter's full-text reading (abstract covers HbA1c only); empagliflozin oral; built after both trials' BHB were public, so retro holds.
Tahara 2014 (PMID 24533859, epub 2014-02-17) quote verbatim; ipragliflozin in STZ type 1 diabetic rats; prospective opener, untested 2014 holds.

Kaku 2019 (PMID 31173455, epub 2019-07-11) conclusion quote verbatim; primary HbA1c -0.36% met; ipragliflozin 50 mg oral plus background insulin; Japanese adults coded unselected. Japan approved the T1D indication 2018-12-21; that press release gives no results, so 2019 stands.
DEPICT-2 quote verbatim (2.6%/2.2% vs 0%); dapagliflozin oral, unselected; model_src Meng 2008 silent on ketones, a harm rats can show; contra 2018 holds.
Tahara 2014 conclusion quote verbatim; abstract has no ketone readout; ipragliflozin oral opener, untested 2014 holds.

entries.rule: rule 5 (untested_reason no_prediction); safety: silence scores only when contradicted
entries.note: Kaku quote verbatim. Tahara 2014 states no ketone or tolerability finding; silence that patients did not contradict is no prediction, so untested with untested_reason no_prediction. The entry already carries untested_reason no_prediction while status is same.
entries.adjudication_note: Tahara 2014 states no tolerability or ketone finding; uncontradicted silence is no stated prediction, so no admissible comparison. Rule 5: untested, untested_reason no_prediction (already on the draft entry).

missing: Devenny 2012 (https://doi.org/10.1038/oby.2012.59, PMID 22402735, epub 2012-03-08): dapagliflozin raised fasting beta-hydroxybutyrate in diet-induced obese rats, a member-drug rodent model that showed the ketone signal before any T1D trial; the draft sets it aside in judgement. No source compares it with patients, so a candidate track only (rule question 3).

Vallon 2013 (https://doi.org/10.1152/ajprenal.00409.2012, PMID 23152292, epub 2012-11-14): Sglt2 knockout in Akita mice prevented glomerular hyperfiltration, the same system and prediction as the akita-mouse track one year earlier by genetic deletion; model_first_use_year 2013 should be 2012 (no status change).

Tahara 2014 (https://doi.org/10.1111/jphp.12223, PMID 24533859, epub 2014-02-17): ipragliflozin in STZ type 1 diabetic rats, the third member on the stz-rat track; same system, no status change, worth citing against Kaku 2019.

rule_questions: Dose cell when the filed model gave only an mg/kg dose-response, stated no exposure, occupancy or regimen target, and the dose inherited from T2D worked: is that `untested` (no prediction to test) or `same` under the table row 'reached, drug worked'? The v3 table has no row for a model that set no target.

Prospective versus retrodiction when the model paper's online date precedes the trial paper's online date by 30 days but the trial finished 15 months earlier (Vallon 2014 epub 2013-11-13; Cherney 2014 epub 2013-12-13, NCT01392560 completed 2012-08): does 'the clinic already knew' run from trial completion, meeting presentation, or publication?

A member-drug model in a different physiological state (insulin-replete DIO rat, Devenny 2012) that showed the harm the filed insulin-deficient model missed: is it its own safety track (`same`, direction only) or set aside as a different system, as the draft did?

A regulator-imposed dose restriction on safety grounds with no model margin (EMA kept dapagliflozin 5 mg only; FDA rejected empagliflozin 2.5 mg): confirm decision 16 leaves dose `untested` and scores the harm once in safety, rather than `contra` with blocked_by toxicity.

A stated null in a filed model whose physiology precludes the harm (NDA 206111 ZDF rat: hyperinsulinaemic, plasma insulin rose on empagliflozin, 'ketone bodies were unremarkable') set against T1D DKA: `contra` as a failed stated prediction (decision 4 safety row) or `untested` as a condition the model never tested (#35/#72, #87)? #58 settles null-null but not null-in-model/harm-in-patients. [CHECKER_BRIEF_v3 / models]

A model silent on a harm, set against patients who also showed none (ipragliflozin STZ rat vs Kaku 2019 no DKA): `same` (silence held) or `untested` no_prediction? The brief scores silence only when contradicted. [CHECKER_BRIEF / fields]
